Package org.apache.juneau.bean.mcp.v20260728

Class CreateMessageRequest

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.bean.mcp.v20260728.CreateMessageRequest
@Marshalled public class CreateMessageRequest extends Object
Parameters for "sampling/createMessage", a server-to-client duplex request (MCP sampling). Never dispatched through McpRevision — this is a plain POJO decoded/encoded by hand (or via the client's typed duplex flow) inside an McpServerRequestHandler implementation.
